page.layout: One column of italic running text at the top, ending with the date line; below it, a right-aligned title "PROTREPTICON" in capitals. Running head "EPISTOLA" centred at the top. No page number, no catchword, no notes in the margins.

p.i: gratiam & vsum Electorum omnium, qui tum exauthorati Euangelicam veritatem suo sangui-ne gloriosissimè consignauerunt; tum merentes adhuc imperatore Christo, pari (si res tulerit) constantia in pulverem & aciem prodituri sunt. quod ipsum & ad breuitatem mihi est aptius, & ad reliqua quaedam quae suo loco & tempore tibi sumus exhibituri, prouidentius. Vale Christiane Le-ctor; & dum reliquorum seriem expectas, his ad gloriam tu Domini, & salutem tuam frui perge. Geneuae, V. Calend. Martij. M. D. LX.

page.notes: Long s is read as plain s throughout (e.g. "suo", "sanguine", "consignauerunt"). The date numeral "M." is read from an italic form that resembles N; it is copied as M. Otherwise no damage or doubtful readings.
